title: Robust Bias Detection in MLMs and its Application to Human Trait Ratings
measurement_description: The paper measured stereotypical bias related to religion by analyzing the difference in association scores (pseudo-log likelihood) between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentence pairs from the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
findings: Using their proposed statistical methodology on the CrowS-Pairs dataset, the paper found no significant religious bias in the RoBERTa-large model. While stereotypical sentences were slightly preferred over anti-stereotypical ones, the differences were deemed insignificant.
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. 2023. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.08774.
